method: Assistant inspected contact sheet of all six retained original1280x720BMPs; sheet is only a display preview

observations.label: title_ready
observations.observation: Paradise title scene and Press START visible; ordinary title rendering.

observations.label: car_select
observations.observation: Red/orange car front three-quarter view in junkyard; background rendered, motion blur visible.

observations.label: world_exit
observations.observation: Black transition with EA loading mark and diagnostic HUD, captured as StreamingFinished was first observed; this frame does not prove visible world rendering.

observations.label: drive_8s
observations.observation: Rendered industrial road/buildings, rear chase car, sky, Road Rage prompt, HUD and minimap visible.

observations.label: drive_15s
observations.observation: Rendered street junction at Patterson Av / E.Crawford Dr, chase car and HUD/minimap visible; viewpoint differs from earlier road capture.

observations.label: drive_25s
observations.observation: Rendered industrial fence/building, car pushing into fence with tyre smoke under straight throttle; HUD and minimap persist.

limits: world_exit capture is the black EA loading transition, not a rendered-world witness; three later original captures prove visible road/world/car/HUD
Later straight-throttle scene is a car pushing against a fence, not proof of steering or organic route navigation
Ordinary input-driven motion is separately measured by unchanged canonical drive check
Existing diagnostics are visible; no debug source flag or camera override was applied
